# NANIKA

> > NANIKA is a curated platform showcasing Japanese fashion culture, from emerging designers like BIÉDE to vintage stores across Japan.

NANIKA serves as a discovery hub for Japanese fashion enthusiasts, featuring comprehensive guides to rising brands, established designer labels, and vintage shopping destinations. The platform highlights next-generation designers like Ryuya Kimura and Emily Oda alongside cultural hubs like Harajuku and Grounds.

## Key Topics

- Japanese fashion
- Emerging designers
- BIÉDE
- Ryuya Kimura

- Vintage stores
- Harajuku

- Grounds

## Japanese Fashion Brands

- [Japanese rising brands](https://nanikajapan.com/japanese-rising-brands): Curated showcase of emerging Japanese fashion brands & designers like BIÉDE
- [Japanese designer brands](https://nanikajapan.com/japanese-designer-brands): Guide to established Japanese designer brands like Studio d'Artisan

- [Vintage stores category](https://nanikajapan.com/japan-vintage-stores-guide/vintage-stores-category): Directory of Japanese vintage stores by category including A.A VINTAGE TOKYO
